contract.definition: saleLines: Set(SalesLineItem) = SalesLineItem.allInstances()->select(line: SalesLineItem | line.BelongedSale = self.CurrentSale), resultingAmount: Real = if saleLines->isEmpty() then 0.0 else saleLines->sumBy(line: SalesLineItem | line.Subamount) endif
contract.precondition: self.CurrentSale.oclIsUndefined() = false and self.CurrentSale.IsComplete = false and self.CurrentSale.IsReadytoPay = false
contract.postcondition: self.CurrentSale.Amount = resultingAmount and self.CurrentSale.IsReadytoPay = true and self.CurrentSale.IsComplete = true and result = resultingAmount
